quote: The reconstruction multiplies the complete neutral portal by 2: $\mathcal{L} = 2c_1\,\epsilon\,Z X \partial B$. The paper gives this operator with a single power of $c_1$ (eq. 48, eq. 15)... The factor 2 therefore doubles both neutral amplitudes and multiplies the $ZZ$ and $Z\gamma$ partial widths by 4.
other_list: D2 (substantive part): the paper's own eq. (40) and eq. (41) are not mutually consistent on the ZZX vertex normalization (eq. 41 plus the W+W- width imply an effective coefficient of about c1 sW/sqrt2, while eq. (40) states 1/2 c1 sW) -- a normalization ambiguity in the paper itself, separate from the reconstruction's factor-2 defect.

D4 (substantive, scope): the reconstruction works in unitary gauge and omits the Stuckelberg field theta_X and D theta_X = d theta_X + X (eq. 39), the SU(2) x U(1)_Y x U(1)_X covariant portal form (eq. 48), and the resulting X-gamma-H and X-Z-H vertices plus the O(dh/v) terms of eq. (15).
note: The reviewer isolates the injected factor-of-2 defect as the single clear issue and tells the physicist to fix it first because it changes two branching ratios by a factor of 4, which sends the reader to the right place.
